author: praasz
title: GPU unit tests CMake glob removal missing two test source files
signature: cmake error at add_target_helpers.cmake message exists on disk but is not listed in target sources and will not be compiled add it to the appropriate cmakelists txt or sources cmake|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure step fails: two GPU unit test source files exist on disk but are not listed in target sources

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/add_target_helpers.cmake:635 (message):
  [ov_gpu_unit_tests]
  '/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp'
  exists on disk but is not listed in target sources and will not be

CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/add_target_helpers.cmake:635 (message):
  [ov_gpu_unit_tests]
  '/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/transformations/remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp'
  exists on disk but is not listed in target sources and will not be
  compiled.  Add it to the appropriate CMakeLists.txt or sources.cmake.
root_cause: PR #37914 replaced a CMake glob-based file collection in src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit with an explicit source list in sources.cmake/CMakeLists.txt. The new explicit list omits two existing test files (group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp and remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp), which the developer_package's _ov_check_all_sources_listed() consistency check (add_target_helpers.cmake:635) detects and fails CMake configure on, exactly the risk an explicit-list migration is prone to.
reproduction_steps: cmake -S . -B build -DENABLE_TESTS=ON (with GPU plugin enabled) after checking out PR #37914's branch; configure fails with the two CMake Error messages above.
recommended_actions: Add 'transformations/group_query_attention_decomposition_test.cpp' and 'transformations/remove_fq_before_dw_conv_test.cpp' to src/plugins/intel_gpu/tests/unit/sources.cmake (or CMakeLists.txt) in PR #37914
Re-run the _ov_check_all_sources_listed consistency check locally (cmake configure) before pushing to confirm no other files were missed
prevention_strategies: When migrating a CMakeLists.txt/sources.cmake away from file(GLOB ...) to an explicit list, diff the glob's output against the new explicit list (e.g., via `file(GLOB_RECURSE ...)` in a scratch script) to guarantee 1:1 parity before submitting the PR.
historical_context: Identical failure previously recorded for this same PR #37914 in investigation 2026-09-08-05-13-38-000-34188369195.json (run 34188369195, ~1.5 hours earlier) — same two missing files, same signature. This is the second occurrence of the same unresolved code issue on the same PR.
